data.exact_reserve_text: The net loss ratio for the financial year improved to 88.9% (2018: 104.2%) driven by reserve releases in older years of account due to better than expected claims experience. However, increased claims provisions on the 2019 year of account offset these releases, driven by catastrophe events (Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi and Hurricane Dorian) and other attritional losses related to wind, storm and hail.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 2.309 million, primarily driven by favorable claims development in older years of account, which contributed to an improved net loss ratio. However, this release was partially offset by increased claims provisions for the current 2019 year of account, attributed to catastrophe events including Typhoon Hagibis, Typhoon Jebi (from 2018), and Hurricane Dorian, as well as other attritional losses related to wind, storm and hail.
raw_causal_phrases: reserve releases in older years of account due to better than expected claims experience
data.data_quality_notes: Gross premium mix from divisional summary as no regulatory segmental analysis was provided. The narrative mentions Typhoon Jebi (2018) as contributing to increased claims provisions in the 2019 year of account, not as a prior year reserve movement for 2018 itself.
